criteria: Given a spec file whose path contains a comma (e.g. specs/a,b.md), when recordVerdict is called with specPath, then the manifest entry records a single non-null SHA-256 hash under files["specs/a,b.md"] and does not split the path on commas.
Given a specPath that does not exist or cannot be read (hashes to null), when recordVerdict is called, then it throws an error instead of recording a null hash in the manifest.
intent: Resolve #724: packages/premortem/lib/verdict.mjs passes specPath as rawFiles to GateManifest.record, which splits on commas and ignores null hashes when recording premortem verdict evidence. Hash [specPath] directly via hashFiles and appendManifestEntry (matching packages/spec-lint/lib/record.mjs) and fail closed when specPath hashes to null.
title: fix(premortem): hash specPath directly without comma-splitting and reject unreadable spec files
